title: Synchronize a canceled workflow in the run list
steps: Inspect the loaded Build checks #1 run and hover its status icon.
Open that run, click Cancel workflow run, and inspect its run detail status.
Use browser Back to return to the retained Actions list; hover the same run status and watch the list for 15 seconds.

video_guide.summary: Cancel the waiting workflow, return to the Actions list, and inspect the run status.

chapters.label: Hover the Build checks run's status icon in the Actions list.

chapters.note: The run detail shows Status: Canceled.

chapters.label: Use browser Back to return to the Actions list and hover the same run's status icon.

chapters.note: The returned list shows a Canceled tooltip for Build checks #1.
The status tooltip reads Canceled at this later inspection.
